You are an AI assistant tasked with solving command-line tasks in a Linux environment. You will be given a task description and the output from previously executed commands. Your goal is to solve the task by providing batches of shell commands.

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",
  "commands": [
    {{
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }},
    {{
      "keystrokes": "cd project\\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }}
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used as shell commands.
- Most bash commands should end with a newline (\n) to cause them to execute
- For special key sequences, use: C-c for Ctrl+C, C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies wait time:
- 0.1 seconds for instant commands (cd, ls, echo, cat)
- 1.0 seconds for normal commands (gcc, find, rustc)
- 5-30 seconds for slow commands (make, python scripts, wget)

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are executed in sequence
- Do not include extra whitespace unless it's part of the command
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action
- Set task_complete to true ONLY when the task is fully finished and verified
- CRITICAL: BEFORE writing any code or modifying files, you MUST explore the workspace and read the provided documentation (e.g., `cat skill.md` or `cat task_spec.json`) to learn the required skills and constraints.
- DO NOT rely solely on your pre-trained knowledge. Base your implementation strictly on the context provided in the workspace documents.

Create a new file named revenue_model_plan.txt that includes: a primary revenue stream, one secondary stream, one opportunistic stream, pricing cadence, payment flow, and a 12-month revenue projection summary. Keep the output practical and internally consistent. Do not modify the source notes file.

A revenue model is not just "how much do I charge" — it is the complete system of how value translates into money. The wrong model can make a great product fail (people love it but won't pay the way you structured it). The right model turns a good product into a sustainable business. This playbook helps you choose, design, and validate the right model for your specific situation.

REVENUE MODEL PLAN
Niche B2B Newsletter & Micro-Tools for Bookkeeping Firms

=== PRIMARY REVENUE STREAM ===
Premium Newsletter Subscription
- Monthly recurring subscription delivering audit checklists, compliance updates, and ready-made templates
- Targets 1,240 existing free subscribers with 5-8% conversion goal
- Pricing: $29/month or $290/year (save 2 months)
- Rationale: Provides predictable monthly income with low support burden; aligns with audience demand for recurring updates

=== SECONDARY REVENUE STREAM ===
Template Pack Sales
- One-time purchases of specialized template bundles (audit checklists, compliance forms, onboarding kits)
- Pricing: $49 per template pack; $129 for "Complete Compliance Bundle"
- Distribution: Standalone purchases and add-ons for subscribers
- Rationale: Proven traction (17 sales already); zero ongoing support; complements subscription offering

=== OPPORTUNISTIC REVENUE STREAM ===
Implementation Consulting
- Limited monthly slots for audit implementation support and custom workflow setup
- Pricing: $500 per session (2-hour block) or $1,500 for full implementation package
- Capacity: 2-4 clients per month maximum (low support burden constraint)
- Rationale: High-margin upsell path; addresses audience request for "occasional implementation help"; foundation for future premium tier

=== PRICING CADENCE ===
- Subscriptions: Monthly auto-renewal with annual discount option
- Templates: One-time purchase, instant digital delivery
- Consulting: Upfront invoice, net-15 for established clients
- All pricing USD; no hidden fees; 30-day satisfaction guarantee on templates

=== PAYMENT FLOW ===
1. Stripe handles all subscription billing and one-time template purchases
2. Automated invoicing via Stripe for consulting (with payment link)
3. Subscribers receive monthly receipts; annual subscribers billed upfront
4. Failed payment automation: 3 retry attempts, then grace period notification
5. Revenue tracked monthly via Stripe dashboard; payouts to business account

=== 12-MONTH REVENUE PROJECTION SUMMARY ===

Assumptions:
- 5% conversion of 1,240 free subscribers = 62 premium subscribers by month 6
- Template sales: 10/month (growing to 15/month by month 12)
- Consulting: 2 clients/month average

Quarterly Breakdown:
Q1 (Months 1-3): $7,500

  - Templates: $490/month
  - Consulting: $1,000/month

  - Subscription: $1,500/month (52 subs avg)
  - Templates: $625/month
  - Consulting: $1,000/month

Q3 (Months 7-9): $11,700
  - Subscription: $1,800/month (62 subs avg)
  - Templates: $735/month
  - Consulting: $1,000/month

Q4 (Months 10-12): $13,500
  - Subscription: $2,100/month (73 subs avg)
  - Templates: $850/month
  - Consulting: $1,000/month

Annual Total: $42,600
Monthly Average: $3,550

Key Milestones:
- Month 3: Reach 50 premium subscribers
- Month 6: Launch Complete Compliance Bundle ($129)
- Month 9: Test premium tier upsell features
- Month 12: Evaluate pricing increase for new subscribers

=== NOTES ===
- All projections assume consistent newsletter quality and engagement
- Low support burden maintained through automated delivery and templated responses
- Premium tier upsell path prepared for Year 2 (white-label tools, advanced analytics)
EOF\n",
